description: This file contains core functions for managing git objects such as commits, trees, blobs, and tags, including hash table management, object parsing, and object lookup logic.

methods.name: unsigned int get_max_object_index(const struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Returns the maximum object index size in the repository.

methods.name: struct:object * get_indexed_object(const struct repository * repo,unsigned int idx)
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the repository's parsed objects by index.

methods.name: const char * type_name(unsigned int type)
methods.description: Converts a numeric object type to its string representation.

methods.name: int type_from_string_gently(const char * str,ssize_t len,int gentle)
methods.description: Parses a string to get the corresponding object type; handles invalid types based on 'gentle' flag.

methods.name: struct:object * lookup_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up an object in the repository by its object ID.

methods.name: struct:object * lookup_unknown_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds or creates an object with a given ID, even if unknown.

methods.name: struct:object * lookup_object_by_type(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type)
methods.description: Looks up an object by ID and desired type.

methods.name: enum:peel_status peel_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * name,struct object_id * oid,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Peels a tagged object to its underlying object, following tags.

methods.name: struct:object * parse_object_buffer(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,enum object_type type,unsigned long size,void * buffer,int * eaten_p)
methods.description: Parses raw object data buffer into a structured object of given type.

methods.name: struct:object * parse_object_or_die(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name)
methods.description: Parses an object by ID, aborts if parsing fails.

methods.name: struct:object * parse_object_with_flags(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,enum parse_object_flags flags)
methods.description: Parses an object with specific flags controlling behavior.

methods.name: struct:object * parse_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Default object parsing with no special flags.

methods.name: struct:object_list * object_list_insert(struct object * item,struct object_list ** list_p)
methods.description: Inserts an object into an object list.

methods.name: int object_list_contains(struct object_list * list,struct object * obj)
methods.description: Checks if an object list contains a specific object.

methods.name: void object_list_free(struct object_list ** list)
methods.description: Frees all entries in an object list.

methods.name: void object_array_init(struct object_array * array)
methods.description: Initializes an object array.

methods.name: void add_object_array_with_path(struct object * obj,const char * name,struct object_array * array,unsigned mode,const char * path)
methods.description: Adds an object to an array with associated path.

methods.name: void add_object_array(struct object * obj,const char * name,struct object_array * array)
methods.description: Adds an object to an array without a path.

methods.name: struct:object * object_array_pop(struct object_array * array)
methods.description: Removes and returns the last object from an array.

methods.name: void object_array_filter(struct object_array * array,object_array_each_func_t want,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Filters objects in the array based on a predicate.

methods.name: void object_array_clear(struct object_array * array)
methods.description: Clears all objects from an array.

methods.name: void clear_object_flags(struct repository * repo,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Clears specified flags from all objects in the repository.

methods.name: void repo_clear_commit_marks(struct repository * r,unsigned int flags)
methods.description: Clears commit flags in the repository.

methods.name: struct:parsed_object_pool * parsed_object_pool_new(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Creates a new parsed object pool.

methods.name: void parsed_object_pool_reset_commit_grafts(struct parsed_object_pool * o)
methods.description: Resets commit grafts in the parsed object pool.

methods.name: void parsed_object_pool_clear(struct parsed_object_pool * o)
methods.description: Clears and frees the parsed object pool.

methods.name: void * create_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,void * o)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void grow_object_hash(struct repository * r)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: unsigned int hash_obj(const struct object_id * oid,unsigned int n)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void insert_obj_hash(struct object * obj,struct object ** hash,unsigned int size)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void object_array_release_entry(struct object_array_entry * ent)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void * object_as_type(struct object * obj,enum object_type type,int quiet)
methods.description: unavailable
